incident.title: payments-api Connection Pool Starvation and Spike in 504 Gateway Timeouts (2026-06-05)
incident.impact: Payment processing halted for 64 minutes; 1066 checkout attempts failed with HTTP 504; p99 latency spiked to 6,800ms.
error_logs: ERROR 2026-06-05 16:49:00 payments-api.pool: sqlalchemy.exc.TimeoutError: QueuePool limit of size 20 overflow 5 reached, connection timed out, timeout 15.00
FATAL 2026-06-05 17:03:00 payments-api.gateway: [CheckoutGate] upstream payments-api worker exhausted, returning HTTP 504
WARN  2026-06-05 17:08:00 payments-api.health: liveness probe failed: HTTP 503 connection refused
incident.root_cause: Friday evening batch settlement traffic on 2026-06-05 coincided with reduced pool_max_connections (decreased from 50 to 20) and high keepalive_timeout_ms (15s), preventing worker connections from recycling.
incident.fix_steps: Reverted pool_max_connections to 60, decreased keepalive timeout to 3000ms, and performed rolling restart of payments-api pods.
incident.runbook: RB-PAY-04: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion & Recovery

incident.title: search-indexer and reporting-service Crash Loop on Dropped Ledger Column (2026-08-06)
incident.impact: Merchant transaction search offline for 45 minutes; overnight reporting pipeline halted; 12,000 ledger events queued in Kafka DLQ.
error_logs: CRITICAL 2026-08-06 15:24:00 search-indexer.consumer: KeyError: 'legacy_settlement_id' missing from CDC event payload
ERROR 2026-08-06 15:42:00 reporting-service.pipeline: psycopg2.errors.UndefinedColumn: column ledger_entries.legacy_settlement_id does not exist
FATAL 2026-08-06 15:56:00 search-indexer: ConsumerGroupOffsetExpiredException: max retry limit exceeded on topic ledger.events
incident.root_cause: Destructive schema migration in ledger-service on 2026-08-06 dropped legacy_settlement_id immediately without a multi-phase deprecation or backfill phase, crashing downstream consumers.
incident.fix_steps: Executed hotfix migration adding back legacy_settlement_id as a generated column aliased to settlement_epoch, resumed Kafka consumer offsets.
incident.runbook: RB-DB-02: Zero-Downtime Schema Evolution & Consumer Recovery

incident.title: search-indexer Shard Allocation Rejection on High Disk Watermark (2026-08-10)
incident.impact: search-indexer operational degradation for 56 minutes; background incident unrelated to CI/CD pipeline pattern.
error_logs: WARN  2026-08-10 10:37:00 search-indexer.monitor: Resource threshold exceeded warning on cluster worker node
ERROR 2026-08-10 11:29:00 search-indexer.core: Unexpected runtime failure: search-indexer Shard Allocation Rejection on High Disk Watermark
FATAL 2026-08-10 11:30:00 search-indexer.supervisor: Worker heartbeats missed, triggering automated alert
incident.root_cause: ElasticSearch data node crossed 85% low-watermark threshold, preventing primary shard reallocation after a node replacement. Occurred on 2026-08-10.
incident.fix_steps: Expanded EBS volume from 250GB to 500GB and triggered cluster reroute with retry_failed=true.

incident.title: checkout-web HTTP 401 Unauthorized Spike Following Auth JWT Upgrade (2026-08-11)
incident.impact: Valid logged-in users rejected at checkout page with 'Session Expired' for 84 minutes; 3392 checkout abandonments.
error_logs: WARN  2026-08-11 16:11:00 checkout-web.auth: jwt.exceptions.InvalidAlgorithmError: The specified alg 'RS256' requires strict key format validation in pyjwt>=2.10
ERROR 2026-08-11 16:32:00 checkout-web.session: Failed to decode user session token from Authorization header: verification failed
INFO  2026-08-11 16:42:00 auth-service: Rejected token issue: clock skew tolerance exceeded (0s threshold)
incident.root_cause: auth-service pyjwt dependency upgrade on 2026-08-11 enforced strict asymmetric key formatting and zero leeway on clock skew, rejecting valid JWT tokens issued by older client instances.
incident.fix_steps: Configured jwt.decode leeway=10s and aligned public key PEM header formatting; rolled back auth-service to pyjwt 2.8.0 pending client rollout.
incident.runbook: RB-SEC-09: JWT Token Invalidation & Algorithm Rotation

incident.title: notification-service Egress Timeout & Queue Overflow on Blocked Port 587 (2026-08-19)
incident.impact: Payment confirmation receipts, 2FA OTP codes, and fraud alerts delayed by up to 72 minutes.
error_logs: ERROR 2026-08-19 17:46:00 notification-service.mailer: OSError: [Errno 110] Connection timed out while connecting to email-smtp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com:587
WARN  2026-08-19 18:06:00 notification-service.queue: Redis queue 'email_notifications' exceeded 25,000 pending items
ERROR 2026-08-19 18:20:00 notification-service.worker: MaxRetryError: SQS message failed 5 times, sending to dead_letter_queue
incident.root_cause: Terraform security group update on 2026-08-19 tightened default egress to port 443 only, inadvertently dropping outbound TCP traffic on port 587 needed by notification-service.
incident.fix_steps: Added explicit egress rule in terraform security_groups.tf allowing outbound TCP port 587 to AWS SES CIDR ranges; ran terraform apply and flushed delayed queue.
incident.runbook: RB-INFRA-07: VPC Security Group & Egress Connectivity Troubleshooting
